parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set protocols ldp interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: 在指定接口上启用LDP协议。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce all
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute announce all
set protocols mpls traffic-eng autoroute.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程自动路由通告所有路由。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng priority.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的优先级。

set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-opti.template: set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-option [parameter1] explicit host-name [parameter2] destination [parameter3]
set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-opti.command: set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-option 10 explicit host-name Tunnel10 destination 3.3.3.3
set protocols mpls traffic-eng path-opti.explanation: 配置MPLS流量工程的路径选项。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 2.1.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet un.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet unnumbered [parameter3]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet un.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet unnumbered vlan management
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet un.explanation: 配置接口使用未编号的IP地址，并指定VLAN。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT1 tunnel-type.template: set vlans管理名 space vfi [parameter1] tunnel-type mpls traffic-eng bandwidth [parameter2]
set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT1 tunnel-type.command: set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT1 tunnel-type mpls traffic-eng bandwidth 100000
set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT1 tunnel-type.explanation: 配置VLAN的VFI和MPLS流量工程隧道的带宽。

set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT2 tunnel-type.template: set vlans管理名 space vfi [parameter1] tunnel-type mpls traffic-eng bandwidth [parameter2] [parameter3]
set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT2 tunnel-type.command: set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT2 tunnel-type mpls traffic-eng bandwidth 100000 100000
set vlans管理名 space vfi LPT2 tunnel-type.explanation: 配置VLAN的VFI和MPLS流量工程隧道的带宽，包括两个带宽值。

set forwarding-rules family inet route 2.template: set forwarding-rules family inet route [parameter1]/[parameter2] next-hop [parameter3]
set forwarding-rules family inet route 2.command: set forwarding-rules family inet route 2.2.2.2/32 next-hop 2.1.1.2

set forwarding-rules family inet route 3.template: set forwarding-rules family inet route [parameter1]/[parameter2] next-hop [parameter3]
